e2e_tests.description: ai-factory has no subprocess-e2e with scripted echo provider. The BIFR gold tests (tests/bifr/) use TestModel for boundary/freeze/replay but without inline-snapshot assertions on normalized event sequences. No Playwright-style e2e with mocked wire protocol.
e2e_tests.gap: No subprocess-e2e + scripted-echo + snapshot() pattern to lock down multi-agent handover behavior. No MockProvider for each tier (intern/engineer/senior) to test handover determinism. No inline-snapshot snapshot() on normalized event/message sequences.

proposal: ai-factory has 329 tests but no MockProvider or scripted-response pattern for 3-tier handover — the existing TestModel usage (tests/test_loopguard.py:29) only covers compaction-gate unit tests, not the intern→engineer→senior tier handover. No subprocess-e2e with scripted echo provider, no inline-snapshot assertions on normalized event sequences, and factory/tests/ (isolated testing subdir) has no TestModel/MockProvider pattern at all. OpenWorker's pattern: mock provider returns scripted tool_call/reply sequences, Playwright e2e with mocked /v1 + WS endpoints, no real API calls in CI. The kimi-cli KC-06 research showed the exact pattern: TestModel with predefined outputs + inline-snapshot locks the entire agent loop deterministically. ai-factory should adopt a TestModel + inline-snapshot pattern so the 3-tier intern→engineer→senior handover can be tested deterministically without real LLM calls.

pydantic_ai_2_impl.pattern: Pydantic-AI TestModel with predefined tool_call/reply sequences + inline-snapshot assertions on normalized event stream — locks turn/step/tool-call ordering so evals catch orchestration regressions instead of hallucination noise.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.code:
from pydantic_ai import Agent
from pydantic_ai.models.test import TestModel
from pydantic_ai.messages import (
    ToolCallPart,
    TextPart,
    ToolReturnPart,
)

# Scripted responses: model emits a tool_call, then text
mock_model = TestModel()

agent = Agent(mock_model, output_type=str, retries=3)
result = agent.run_sync('replace some text in test.py')

# Inline-snapshot on normalized message sequence
assert result.all_messages == snapshot([
    {'role': 'user', 'content': 'replace some text in test.py'},
    {'role': 'assistant', 'content': '', 'tool_calls': [{'name': 'replace_text', 'args': {'old': 'old', 'new': 'new'}}]},
    {'role': 'tool', 'content': '{"status": "ok"}', 'tool_call_id': '...'}
    {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'Done! I have made the edit.'}
])

# Test the 3-tier handover: intern → engineer → senior
# MockModel replays the SAME scripted sequence for each tier
# — if the handover changes the message ordering, snapshot breaks
pydantic_ai_2_impl.why_now: ai-factory's LLMs keep failing non-deterministically because the 3-tier handover tests use TestModel only for compaction-gate isolation (tests/test_loopguard.py:120-140), not for scripted handover eval. You cannot reproduce a hallucination failure to fix it. OpenWorker's test_engine.py + test_subagent.py prove that scripted mock responses + normalized assertions catch orchestration regressions. The kimi-cli KC-06 research showed this exact pattern: TestModel with predefined outputs + inline-snapshot locks the entire agent loop deterministically.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.harness_gap: TestModel eval strategy lands at tests/test_loopguard.py:29 (import) and tests/test_loopguard.py:89,120,139,140,299 (usage in compaction gate + loop-guard mock model), tests/bifr/test_replay.py:7,14,21 (usage in replay harness), tests/bifr/test_freeze.py:19,28 (freeze snapshot), tests/bifr/test_boundary.py:6,15 (boundary edges), tests/test_loopguard_recovery.py:31,45 (recovery). However, factory/tests/ (isolated testing subdir, pyproject.toml testpaths=['tests']) has NO TestModel/MockProvider pattern — only test_dynamic_budget.py. No inline-snapshot snapshot() assertions on normalized event sequences anywhere in tests/. No scripted echo provider for subprocess-e2e. The HarnessProbe at tests/_probe.py:28 records BIFR events (pre_llm/post_llm/freeze/intercept) but has no snapshot-based eval gate to lock intern→engineer→senior handover ordering — adopt TestModel with scripted ToolCall/ToolReturn/TextPart sequences, snapshot() assertions on normalized message histories, MockProvider for each tier to test handover determinism.
